messages.author: Lee, Chris
messages.body:
Hello,
I am trying to install AmberTools23 on a m1 mac using anaconda.
I had AmberTools22 before and I think I've used the same method to install it however, it seems like there isn't ambertools for osx arm 64 anymore.
If I run:
conda install -c conda-forge ambertools=23
It will return:
PackagesNotFoundError: The following packages are not available from current channels:
- ambertools=23
Current channels:
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/osx-arm64
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/noarch
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/osx-64/osx-arm64
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/osx-64/noarch
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/osx-arm64
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/noarch
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/free/osx-arm64
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/free/noarch
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r/osx-arm64
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r/noarch
I'm guessing this is because there is only ambertools available for osx-64 and linux but not osx-arm-64.
Could you please let me know why I'm getting this error and let me know if there is any other way to install ambertools on m1 mac using anaconda?
Best regards,
Chris

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, May 06, 2023, Lee, Chris via AMBER wrote:
>I am trying to install AmberTools23 on a m1 mac using anaconda.
>I'm guessing this is because there is only ambertools available for osx-64
>and linux but not osx-arm-64.
Your guess is correct: we don't have a conda build for ambertools23 on
arm. You can see this at
https://anaconda.org/conda-forge/ambertools
.
AmberTools22 is there for arm, but not AmberTools23.
I'll raise an issue at github.com/conda-forge/ambertools-feedstock, to see
if someone can push this through.
...regards...dac
